decisions.reason: As the firm's core GIS solution-building platform, it is strategically central to consulting and integration work and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
Mobile field data capture fits well with ongoing GIS customer projects and remained prominently presented, so it is worth retaining unless demand clearly weakens.
The search extension was still versioned and marketed in 2019, but as a narrower add-on it has a higher discontinuation risk than the platform products, though we would still keep it for now.
